subject: SilkRoad AI — APAC dedicated pool request & timeline
messages:
From: Alex Ng <alex.ng@silkroad.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SilkRoad AI — APAC dedicated pool request & timeline

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for taking this — we have a product launch targeted for mid-June in Singapore and need a dedicated inference pool in APAC to meet latency and compliance needs. High-level asks: 

- Target go-live: 2027-06-10 (public launch)
- Estimated steady-state: 1200 qps (inference requests) across three endpoints, average response 350 tokens; expected peak bursts up to ~4200 qps for 10–15 minute spikes during marketing events.
- Sensitive customer data in payloads; we need a private pool (VPC) and KMS-backed key management.

Attached is our traffic forecast (silkroad_traffic_forecast.xlsx) and a short product note. Can Redwood provide: a) recommended pool sizing (GPU count + equivalent type), b) provisioning timeline including any canary steps, and c) an initial cost estimate or guidance on reserved commit levels?

Procurement is cc'd (procurement@silkroad.ai) — if you need an NDA or additional security docs, let me know.

Best,
Alex Ng
Head of Infrastructure
SilkRoad AI

Attachment: silkroad_traffic_forecast.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ng <alex.ng@silkroad.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SilkRoad AI — APAC dedicated pool request & timeline

Alex — thanks for the clear brief and the forecast. I've looped in Rishi (capacity planning) and Marissa (sales lead) so we can get a sizing + timeline to you within 24–48 hours. A few quick clarifying Qs to help Rishi size:

1) Are the three endpoints roughly similar in per-request compute, or is one much heavier (e.g., generation vs. embedding)?
2) Do you expect long-running streaming sessions, or mostly short generation calls?
3) Any contract constraints on minimum reserved commit (monthly)?

We'll review the spreadsheet and follow up with an initial recommendation and a proposed canary schedule.

—Soojin
Soojin Lee
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

(Attachment: none)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Alex Ng <alex.ng@silkroad.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SilkRoad AI — APAC dedicated pool request & timeline

Thanks — reviewed the forecast quickly and sketched an initial capacity plan (see inline). Attachment: initial-sizing.pdf (pdf, 130KB).

Summary recommendation (APAC — Singapore region):
- Recommend baseline: 8x A100-equivalent GPUs for sustained 1200 qps across 3 endpoints, assuming tokenization and batching optimizations. This assumes 1.2M tokens/minute steady-state.
- Peak handling: add burst capacity / autoscale to cover 4200 qps spikes; implement a 2x burst buffer (i.e., allow temporary extra capacity) or use model variants with fp16/quantized profiles to reduce per-token cost in bursts.
- Canary: provision a 2-node (A100-eq) canary cluster 2 weeks prior to go-live, validate end-to-end, then scale to baseline.
- Provisioning estimate: 18–21 business days for full reserved pool in SG region with dedicated VPC + KMS config; can accelerate to ~10 business days if we accept hybrid (some shared infra for burst) and commit to a 6–12 month reserved contract.
- Security/compliance: KMS integration and SOC2 evidence request will add 3–5 business days for operations to validate. Recommend a pre-provision security checklist and an exec-level MOU.

Questions for Alex: can you provide endpoint-level p95 latency target and a per-endpoint qps split? Also confirm whether you require strictly isolated hardware (no multi-tenant on burst nodes).

Deal note: I recommend a reserved proposal (DL-4391) that covers baseline + burst credits; Marissa, can you start a draft quote with the above sizing and two pricing options (reserved 6m vs reserved 12m)?

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Capacity Planner, Redwood Inference

Attachment: initial-sizing.pdf

From: Alex Ng <alex.ng@silkroad.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@silkroad.ai, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SilkRoad AI — APAC dedicated pool request & timeline

Rishi / Soojin — thanks, that estimate is in line with our internal thinking. For the qps split: endpoint A (chat/generation) 65% of traffic, endpoint B (summarization) 25%, endpoint C (rerank/embedding-lite) 10%. Typical request size for endpoint A is ~380 tokens returned on average (we included distribution in the spreadsheet). P95 latency target is 450ms for endpoint A.

We do require hardware isolation for baseline (no multi-tenant on baseline GPUs). Burst nodes can be shared if needed. Also we need KMS keys in our tenant; can you confirm Redwood supports customer-managed keys (CMK) for dedicated pools?

Attached: privacy-qa.pdf (pdf, 18KB)

If you can commit to a provisioning date that gives us at least one week of soak before 2027-06-10 (i.e., pool live by 2027-06-02), we can set internal launch milestones accordingly.

Best,
Alex

Attachment: privacy-qa.pdf

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ng <alex.ng@silkroad.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SilkRoad AI — APAC dedicated pool request & timeline

Alex — great, thanks for the split and the latency target. Quick internal summary + next steps so procurement and infra teams have a single source of truth: 

1) Committed baseline: 8 A100-eq GPUs (isolated) in SG region; burst capacity configurable up to additional 8 GPUs (shared) for short spikes.
2) Canary & validation: provision 2-node isolated canary by 2027-05-19 for tests; full baseline to be provisioned by 2027-06-02. Ops estimates 18 business days for full isolated provisioning; we will run an accelerated path and confirm if we can hit 6 business days for hybrid approach.
3) Security: Redwood supports CMK for dedicated pools — ops will start KMS onboarding after procurement signs MOU. Expect 3–5 business days to validate.
4) Commercials: Marissa to circulate two pricing options (6m reserved vs 12m reserved) and draft MOU.

Marissa — can you produce the draft MOU and quote today so procurement can review? Alex / procurement: please review the attached MOU draft and the sizing PDF; if that all looks good, we can lock DL-4391 and start procurement flow.

Thanks — I'll keep you posted on provisioning kick-off.

—Soojin
Soojin Lee
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
